project: Canyon Comet (cycle-17), authored in Cyclotron by Volter's agent; the game shown on cyclotron.videogame.ai
note: Every shipped file is source this project wrote: bpy scripts that build the scene from primitives, TypeScript, React, and textures generate.py makes from a seeded NumPy noise field. No third-party asset is included.

files.change: Renamed. Opened in the editor's Blender 5.2 session and saved there after removing the authoring scaffolding: the "Kart reference • composition" image Empty and its packed kart-reference.png, the "Build Notes" text, its text object and the "Authoring board", and the References and Notes collections. Nothing is packed: the two textures are Images that reference //../textures/asphalt.png and //../textures/sandstone.png, the PNGs beside it in the project, loaded fresh so no byte of the authoring machine's paths remains. scenery_ao.py then baked ambient occlusion into the static scenery in the same session (the desert floor's top face became a 4 m grid; mesas, arch, floor, track, shoulders and racing edges gained a scenery_ao colour attribute, and their materials multiply it, through scenery copies of the two a kart or a shelf also wears). The 1490 objects are otherwise unchanged; the karts are untouched, and canyon.py rebuilds the same objects.
